title: Striker 96
overview:
J.League pros and soccer-loving kids alike, kick off right now with Striker 96! On fields where you can choose every condition, fanatical fans are waiting for you!

Take charge of one of 38 national teams and play international soccer your way. Set your formation and strategy as coach, then take to the pitch outdoors on grass or indoors in arena soccer, playing with fast arcade action or a more realistic simulation style.

- 38 national teams from around the world
- Outdoor and indoor matches
- Arcade and simulation play styles
- 7 camera views and instant replay
- Full-motion video of international match highlights
- Up to 4 players

Jリーガーもサッカー大好き少年も、ストライカー96で今すぐキックオフ！あらゆるコンディションが選べるフィールドでは、熱狂的なファンが君を待っている！
